The custom firmware in action

Version 14, build 1 141 Latest

Released 2026-11-05 · based on the original firmware 012

First release of the dtnprt custom firmware

Footswitches

  • Faster response: a press is recognised about twice as fast as with the original firmware.
  • Short, quick taps are no longer missed.
  • Pressing two switches together (A+B, C+D) works as before.

Boot greeting

  • On boot the screen shows information about the version, the battery status in percent and the chosen mode.

Advanced custom mode

  • The screen shows bank and switch at a glance, e.g. 2-3 for bank 2, switch C.
  • The current bank is shown right after switching the pedal on, and switching banks down from the first bank correctly jumps to the last one.

Status LED

  • The status LED is dimmed.

How to flash

  1. Install SincoOTA on an Android phone and copy the .fwsc file to the phone. Don't rename the file.
  2. Set the pedal switch to H (wireless). Close CubeSuite, turn off Bluetooth on the PC.
  3. Do not pair the pedal with the phone. If it is paired, remove it first (phone Bluetooth settings → FootCtrlPlus → Forget).
  4. In SincoOTA connect to FootCtrlPlus, select the file and start the update. Keep the phone next to the pedal.
  5. The pedal restarts into its update loader once in between and then into the new firmware. If it stays in update mode, use SincoOTA's Mandatory upgrade with the same file.
Recovery: flash FootCtrlPlus_012.fwsc (original firmware) the same way. The update loader is never overwritten, so the pedal can always be flashed again.

Configure

The Web Config edits the pedal's settings (modes, MIDI messages, banks) over Bluetooth in Chrome or Edge. It also shows which firmware version is installed on the pedal.
